hero.subtitle: Riayah Plus was created with a simple belief: care should be organised around the person, not around disconnected services.

origins.title: From Australian experience to care designed for our region
origins.p1: Our journey started in Australia, where we gained first-hand experience working within a mature disability and aged-care environment. Through our experience with MyNDIC, we saw the value of person-centred care, structured support, trained care teams, family involvement, and continuous monitoring of outcomes.
origins.p2: We also saw something equally important: good care is not simply about providing a nurse, therapist or support worker. It is about understanding the person, knowing their goals, coordinating the people involved in their care, and making sure the plan is actually being followed.
origins.highlight: That foundational experience inspired the vision and structure behind Riayah Plus.

australianInsight.title: Adapted, Not Simply Copied
australianInsight.p1: Australia has developed strong approaches to disability and aged care (such as My Aged Care and NDIS), with an emphasis on individual needs, dignity, choice, independence, and the involvement of families in care decisions.
australianInsight.p2: But we do not believe that a model should simply be copied from one country and transferred to another. Riayah Plus takes the lessons we learned in Australia and adapts them to the realities, culture, and values of Qatar, the GCC, and the wider Middle East.
australianInsight.regionalValuesDesc: Families in our region often play a central role in caring for their loved ones. Children are deeply involved in the care of aging parents, and parents coordinate every aspect of support for a child with a disability. Decisions are made collectively, and trust is the foundation between a family and its care team. We designed Riayah Plus around that reality.

coreValues.title: Combining global standards with regional values
coreValues.subtitle: Our goal is to combine clinical excellence with the cultural foundations that matter most to families in Qatar and the GCC.

items.title: Family Involvement
items.desc: Keeping the family informed, respected, and in active partnership throughout every care decision.

items.title: Respect & Dignity
items.desc: Upholding the personal autonomy, comfort, and honour of every person receiving care.

items.title: Privacy & Discretion
items.desc: Ensuring the utmost confidentiality and modesty within the home and across all digital health records.

items.title: Cultural Understanding
items.desc: Care designed to harmonize with local traditions, societal norms, and community life.

items.title: Continuity of Care
items.desc: Seamless handovers, enduring clinician relationships, and persistent progress tracking.

items.title: Technology with Purpose
items.desc: Smart systems that eliminate administrative friction so human care remains genuine and attentive.

journey.title: More than a service. A complete care journey.
journey.subtitle: A person receiving care interacts with several professionals over time: doctors, nurses, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, psychologists, support workers, and coordinators.
journey.problemDesc: When services operate in silos, reports are scattered in different clinics, appointments are managed separately, families have to repeatedly re-explain their story, and clinicians lack the complete clinical picture.
journey.solutionDesc: Riayah Plus connects the entire care journey: assessments, medical reports, goals, care plans, multi-disciplinary services, appointments, progress tracking, and scheduled reviews into one unified ecosystem with the family at the center.

coordinatorSpotlight.title: Families shouldn't have to become care managers
coordinatorSpotlight.subtitle: We believe families should not have to carry the stress of managing schedules, records, and clinician handoffs just to get the right support.
coordinatorSpotlight.coordinatorRole: The Care Coordinator is not there to control the family, they are there to make care easier.
bullets: Understand your family's unique goals, daily routines, and cultural preferences.
Coordinate with doctors, home nurses, therapists, and support specialists.
Organize and synchronize home visits, assessments, and telehealth check-ins.
Monitor session notes and ensure the individualized Care Plan is faithfully executed.

technology.title: Technology that supports people, not replaces them
technology.subtitle: Riayah Plus is powered by advanced technology, but technology is not the centre of our philosophy. Care is.
technology.p1: Our platform organizes health information, connects care teams, simplifies family communication, coordinates appointments, and visualizes milestone progress in real time.
technology.p2: Artificial intelligence assists our clinical teams by summarizing multi-disciplinary notes, organizing reports, and accelerating care plan structuring.
technology.callout: Clinical decisions always remain with qualified healthcare professionals. We believe AI should empower doctors and nurses to provide more attentive, human-centered care, not replace human judgement.

vision.title: Building a new standard for disability and aged care
vision.subtitle: Our ambition goes beyond creating another healthcare app. We are building a lasting culture of care across Qatar and the region.

pillars.title: Trained Care Teams
pillars.desc: Investing in rigorous professional training and modern specialized geriatric & disability care standards.

pillars.title: Career Pathways
pillars.desc: Fostering rewarding, respected long-term career pathways for nurses, therapists, and care workers.

pillars.title: Empowered Families
pillars.desc: Educating and supporting families with complete transparency and actionable health guidance.

pillars.title: Structured Accountability
pillars.desc: Delivering care with consistent oversight, measurable outcomes, and rigorous clinical governance.

vision.gccDesc: Drawing on our experience within advanced care systems in Australia, we understand how care can be more structured, person-centered, and goal-oriented. Today, we bring these learnings and reshape them to fit the needs, values, and culture of our families and communities across Qatar and the wider region.

manifesto.line3: A system built around the family.

cta.title: Join us in reshaping family care
cta.subtitle: Experience the difference of structured, compassionate disability and aged care designed around your loved ones.
